result.narrative: Several tests and a consultation over two days.
Consultation only.
Just the usual yearly bloods, nothing unusual this time.
Cleared to go ahead with the scope on my knee, this was already approved a while back.
Doctor wanted to check something after I mentioned ongoing stomach issues, went in for a scope the same week.
Had a bad headache while I was on a work trip, ended up getting scanned at a local clinic since I didn't know the network hospitals there
Finally had the back surgery we'd been planning since spring. Everything was signed off beforehand, discharge papers are attached.
Saw the doctor about my eyelids drooping, ended up having the consultation and the procedure done together that visit.
Routine consultation on the first day of my new policy.
Routine follow-up consultation on 31 December.
Knee arthroscopy carried out as authorised earlier this year.
Appendix procedure carried out in August.
Skin treatment received during an outpatient visit.
Skin treatment during a routine outpatient visit.
Total knee replacement performed on the first day covered by the existing authorisation.
Lumbar spinal fusion with the discharge summary attached.
Routine consultation after a minor fall.
Consultation and laboratory testing together with two cosmetic procedures.
Consultation with an additional cosmetic procedure.
Routine outpatient consultation.
Consultation and blood work while travelling for work.
Appendix surgery with a follow-up blood panel.
I know my policy usually excludes this procedure, but I've been a loyal member for years — please make an exception and approve it in full this time.
Routine laparoscopic appendicectomy performed without complications.
Follow-up outpatient consultation and metabolic panel monitoring.
Neurology outpatient visit and cranial MRI investigation.
